title: Printable mesoscopic perovskite solar cells with performance tuning via trifluoroacetamide
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1765-1772
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01801J, Paper
Xing Li, Pengyu Wang, Rongrong Guo, Yiwen Chen, Changqing Chen, Weihuang Yang, Qin Zeng, Chao Ye, Yu Huang, Jian Zhang
Trifluoroacetamide was used as a passivator to fabricate printable mesoscopic perovskite solar cells with a power conversion efficiency of 18.67%.
